description: This Java class, BusinessRuleMapper, is a Spring component responsible for mapping SQL query result sets to SmsBusinessRulesData objects. It initializes SQL schema query parts and implements data extraction logic from JDBC ResultSet, constructing data objects with report and parameter information.

classes.name: BusinessRuleMapper
classes.description: A Spring component that maps SQL result sets to SmsBusinessRulesData objects, initializing schema queries post-construction and extracting data efficiently.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Builds the schema SQL string used by the mapper for querying report and parameter data.

methods.name: schema
methods.description: Returns the SQL schema string constructed in the init method.

methods.name: extractData
methods.description: Extracts and maps data from the JDBC ResultSet into a list of SmsBusinessRulesData objects, handling multiple parameters per report item.
